# The table filtering example filters data a visitor would filter

Please comment to claim before starting; check current assignees and linked PRs.

## Context

Row 11 of the Grid & Table slate ([#21142](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/21142#issuecomment-6924949418)), a leaf of #21175 (the Grid & Table group, under #21140).

## The Problem

`examples/tableFiltering` has the table's row of typed header filters, and they work: text, a combobox with type-ahead, a number and a date with an operator, and a three-state boolean. They sit on ten rows under headers such as "Lucky Number" and "Special Date", in a table 300 px high on a white page. A visitor sees a form above a short list and does not learn that this is how a business table is searched.

## The Architectural Reality

- `examples/tableFiltering/`: `MainContainer.mjs` (126 lines; the filter containers are imported from `src/filter/` at `:1` to `:8`; a toolbar with the title and a switch for `showHeaderFilters` at `:23` to `:43`; the table at `:48` with `showHeaderFilters: true` at `:51` and a wrapper fixed at 300 px at `:54`; the columns from `:57`), `MainStore.mjs` (ten inline rows from `:15`), `MainModel.mjs`.
- `neo-config.json` names no themes, so the example runs in the default one only.
- The country combobox loads `resources/examples/data/countries.json` by a relative URL (`MainContainer.mjs:72`), which resolves only when the server root is the repository root.
- No spec file loads the folder.
- Catalog record `table-filtering`. The grid's own filter row is a new example (#21168); this one stays the table's.
- The table is documented in `learn/guides/datahandling/Tables.md`.
- Design authority: "Every renew and every new row is then filed as its own leaf under #21140" (#21142), row 11 of its Grid & Table table; the bar is the one #21140 names: "an example resets, works at phone width, in both themes, by keyboard".

## The Fix

1. **60 to 100 rows whose columns ask for each filter type**, for example customers: a name (text), a country (combobox), open orders (number with an operator), last order (date with an operator), active (boolean).
2. **Headers are business fields.**
3. **The table takes the stage's height**, and the page has both themes with a theme button, after the model of `examples/grid/headerGroups`.
4. One line says what to try, for example "Type in a header field. Combine two filters."
5. The switch that hides the filter row stays.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Each of the five filter types narrows the rows, and two filters combine; a spec under `test/playwright/e2e/table/` asserts one filter of each type.
- [ ] No header names a placeholder such as a lucky number.
- [ ] At 1440 × 900 the table uses the stage's height.
- [ ] Clearing every filter brings all rows back.
- [ ] 390 × 844; both themes; a filter field can be reached and cleared by keyboard, and the PR says with which keys.
- [ ] **Look:** the first frame and one frame with two filters set, at both sizes, are on the PR beside today's frame, and the design seat reads them before code review.
- [ ] The catalog cover is re-shot from the new default state with the producer of #20679, or the PR names the change that brings it.

## Out of Scope

The grid's filter row (#21168); changes to the filter containers under `src/filter/`; moving the folder under `examples/table/`.

## Avoided Traps

- **Porting it to the grid.** The table keeps its own filter card.
- **A filter row over rows that all match.** The data needs variety in every filtered column.

## Related

Parent #21175 · the slate #21142 · #21140 · #21168 · #20500 (the family's captions, closed).
